verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs show four scanning modules (Open Source, Code/SAST, Container, IaC) explicitly designed to cover dependencies, custom code, containers, and infrastructure configs across ecosystems like Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, ARM, and npm packages, and the CLI/IDE/CI integration reinforces broad workflow coverage. Community comments corroborate real-world use scanning JS/npm dependencies and note Snyk's vulnerability DB differs from npm's, supporting genuine ecosystem breadth, though no evidence enumerates the full list of supported languages/package managers (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Ruby, .NET) or independently verifies parity across all of them. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated language/ecosystem support matrix and independent verification of coverage completeness across all major languages.
